chapter: Cage in Louisiana, minstrels and learning fiddle
title: Rabbit Foot minstrel show at Port Gibson
summary: Asked about the Wolcott minstrel show in Port Gibson, Cage remembers the Rabbit Foot shows and liked minstrels; the talk turns to television.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Did you ever know any Wolcotts in Port Gibson?
I know of Mr. Charlie Humphers.

And Mr. Ryan Humphers. Did they have that minstrel show? It seems to me the people in Port Gibson had that rabbit foot show. Did you ever see the rabbit? They did. Yeah. They did. Who was that? Oh, I don't know if they had...
You didn't know those people? Well, no. Well, I remember the rabbit foot show had two of them. Yeah.
Well, Wolcott is the one I'm talking about. Wolcott had one. I don't know if he had two, but I know he had one.
Well, there's nothing there, too. You called Snowball or something like that.
Yeah, I used to like them. He'd tell the televisions going on now and I could tell the video.
It's cheaper, too. Yeah. You don't have to pay anything for a television. That's right. Except when it breaks. Yes, sir. Well...
